claims.text: Annual influenza vax for all COPD pts.
claims.quote: All patients with COPD should be given annual influenza vaccinations.
We recommend the use of PCV20 or PCV21 in patients with COPD.

claims.text: Tdap if ⍉vaccinated in adolescence, plus routine shingles vax (CDC).
claims.quote: in adults with COPD the CDC recommends the Tdap vaccination (also called dTaP/dTPa) to protect against pertussis, in addition to tetanus and diphtheria, in those who were not vaccinated in adolescence, together with routine shingles vaccination.

claims.text: RSV vax: recommended >60 yrs regardless of COPD; COPD pts likely benefit significantly.
claims.quote: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine is recommended for adults over the age of 60 years regardless of COPD diagnosis, but COPD patients are likely to have significant benefit from RSV vaccination.
COVID-19 vaccination is also recommended for patients with COPD.
